title: Roswell material as seed for an exotic alloy R&D program at Wright-Patterson
place_text: Air Force Research Lab, Wright-Patterson AFB

tellings.quote: The theory goes that whatever was recovered at Roswell eventually became a classified R&D seed program at Wright Patterson's Air Force Research Lab.

plain: Michels says that, as the theory goes, whatever was recovered from the 1947 crash at Roswell, New Mexico, which UFO researchers believe was an alien craft, became the seed of a secret research programme at the Air Force Research Lab at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, a programme studying exotic metal alloys. He passes it on as a theory without naming who holds it. If true, it would mean crash material shaped real military research.
